description: Makes the app's matching HTTP requests get a made-up answer instead of the network (the dashboard's Mocks list), for the running session only: rules are cleared when it stops. A rule matches a method (default any) and a URL: match 'prefix' (default; the URL without its query starts with url), 'exact', or 'glob' (* matches anything, / included); a pattern with ? is compared with the whole URL. Scheme and host are case-insensitive. action 'respond' (default) answers with status (default 200), headers (an object), contentType (shortcut for the Content-Type header) and body (text, up to 256 KB); 'timeout' and 'connection_error' make the call fail. delayMs (0-30000) waits first. When several rules match: exact before prefix before glob, then the longer pattern, then a specific method, then the newest. Pass id to replace a rule as a whole (it keeps its id). At most 32 rules. Mocks change what the app does: tell the user, and clear them (clear_network_mocks) when done. Returns the rule, every rule in precedence order and whether the app's SDK runs them (it needs SDK 0.9.0+ with Lionscope.okHttpInterceptor()).

contentType.description: Sets the Content-Type header, e.g. application/json.

enabled.description: false keeps the rule but does not apply it.

method.description: HTTP method, e.g. GET; omitted or '*' = any.

name: set_network_mock
title: Mock an HTTP response
